# Predicting a Grade

Do by hand. A student wants to predict their final grade for the Statistical Machine Learning course using the KNN algorithm with $K = 3$. Seven friends who took the course last year had the following mid-term test scores and grades.



##### a) Estimate the prediction error rate of the algorithm, using the validation-set method, with Friends 2, 3, 4, and 6 as training and Friends 1, 5, 7 as testing data. {-}

<br>


| Friend          |   1   |  2  |  3  |  4  |   5   |  6  |   7   | $\hat{Y}$ |
|-----------------|:-----:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:-----:|:---:|:-----:|:---------:|
| Midterm         |  90   | 88  | 83  | 78  |  85   | 89  |  93   |           |
| Final Grade     | **A** |  A  |  B  |  B  | **A** |  B  | **A** |           |
| Test 1: 90 Dist |       |     |     |     |       |     |       |           |
| Test 1          |       |     |     |     |       |     |       |           |
| Test 5: 85 Dist |       |     |     |     |       |     |       |           |
| Test 5          |       |     |     |     |       |     |       |           |
| Test 7: 93 Dist |       |     |     |     |       |     |       |           |
| Test 7          |       |     |     |     |       |     |       |           |


<br>
<br>
